## Objective
- Redesign the MTD quiz (Variant A) from a modal with inner scroll to a full-screen page with normal document scroll, then apply the original Sage site's link states (default/hover/focus-visible/active) and button/option-card states (default/hover/pressed/focus) on shared classes only.

## Important Details
- **Architecture**: `build-variants.js` is the single source of truth; it patches `mtd-income-tax/index.html` (line 35: `const SRC = path.join(HERE, 'mtd-income-tax', 'index.html')`) to produce `variant-a/index.html` and `variant-b/index.html`. Do NOT edit variants by hand — edit source or build script and re-run.
- **Modal HTML (from build-variants.js)**: Two variants — `MODAL_SRC` (line 65) with backdrop, panel, head (h2+close), iframe, foot; `MODAL_FIGMA_A` (line 79) with hidden title, no head close, close in foot. Trigger is `<a class="score-button button--secondary" href="#mtd-quiz-modal" data-mtd-quiz-trigger aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-control…` (line 175).
- **Quiz embedding**: Same-origin iframe (`#mtd-quiz-frame` / `#mtd-quiz-modal-frame`). `quiz-frame.js` sizes iframe via `scrollHeight`; `quiz-modal.js` handles focus-trap/dialog; `variant-quiz.js` injects Figma CSS and clicks past entry card.
- **Variant A modal CSS**: `.mtd-quiz-modal` is `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9…` — must be removed/rewritten for full-screen normal scroll.
- **Frozen bundle tokens**: styled-components suffixes (`fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`) and `Questions-styles__*` classes.
- **Repo hard rule (AGENTS.md line 17)**: One appearance per button class; `node tooling/check-interaction-contract.js` enforces via headless Chromium + static selector check. No override selectors, no context aliases.
- **States skill**: `skills/shared/states.md` — write rest, hover, focus, active before editing any.
- **No dedicated link-guideline file found**: `skills/shared/` contains audit.md, component-card.md, figma-speed.md, figma-variables.md, iconography.md, imagery.md, pattern-scope.md, states.md. Grep for `score-link|link-state|a:hover|a:focus` in `*.md` returned only AGENTS.md line 17 (button rule). Link states must be derived from `main.css` shared `.score-button`/link rules or the Sage reference site.
- **Verification**: `node tooling/check-interaction-contract.js`, `check-spacing`, `check-markup`; browser-verify at 1280×720 & 1024×540 (Q2 "Before continuing" banner must not clip).
- **Serve**: `python3 -m http.server 8150`; view at `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- **Reference site**: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` for original button/option-card/link states.
- Keep changes minimal; no unrelated file edits; no debug code; do not commit.
- Playwright available in `node_modules` for browser verification.

## Objective
- Redesign the MTD quiz (Variant A) from a "modal with inner scroll" to a "full-screen page with normal document scroll," then apply the original Sage site's link states (default/hover/focus-visible/active) and button/option-card states (default/hover/pressed/focus) on shared classes only.

## Important Details
- **Architecture**: `build-variants.js` is the single source of truth; it patches `mtd-income-tax/index.html` (line 35: `const SRC = path.join(HERE, 'mtd-income-tax', 'index.html')`) to produce `variant-a/index.html` and `variant-b/index.html`. Do NOT edit variants by hand.
- **Modal HTML (from build-variants.js)**: `MODAL_SRC` (line 65) with backdrop, panel, head (h2+close), iframe, foot; `MODAL_FIGMA_A` (line 79) with hidden title, no head close, close in foot. Trigger is `<a class="score-button button--secondary" href="#mtd-quiz-modal" data-mtd-quiz-trigger aria-haspopup="dialog" …` (line 175).
- **Quiz embedding**: Same-origin iframe (`#mtd-quiz-frame` / `#mtd-quiz-modal-frame`). `quiz-frame.js` sizes iframe via `scrollHeight`; `quiz-modal.js` handles focus-trap/dialog; `variant-quiz.js` injects Figma CSS and clicks past entry card.
- **Variant A modal CSS**: `.mtd-quiz-modal` is `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9…` — must be removed/rewritten for full-screen normal scroll.
- **Frozen bundle tokens**: styled-components suffixes (`fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`) and `Questions-styles__*` classes.
- **Repo hard rule (AGENTS.md line 17)**: One appearance per button class; `node tooling/check-interaction-contract.js` enforces via headless Chromium + static selector check. No override selectors, no context aliases.
- **States skill**: `skills/shared/states.md` — "Write rest, hover, focus, and active before editing any of them. One state fixed alone leaves the same defect on the next state."
- **No dedicated link-guideline file found**: Link states must be derived from `main.css` shared `.score-button`/link rules or the Sage reference site.
- **Two directory copies exist**: `mtd-income-tax/` (primary, larger CSS/JS) and `page/` (older/simpler copy: `quiz-page.css` 4262 B vs 11144 B; `quiz-modal.js` 3542 B vs 4057 B; also has `index-modal.html`, `REPORT.md`, `screenshots/`, `evidence/`). AGENTS.md route says quiz: `page/quiz/`.
- **Quiz app entry**: `mtd-income-tax/quiz/index.html` + `vendor/` subdirectory + `assets/`, `favicon.svg`, `solution-finder-glow.svg`, `robots.txt`.
- **Verification**: `node tooling/check-interaction-contract.js`, `check-spacing`, `check-markup`; browser-verify at 1280×720 & 1024×540 (Q2 "Before continuing" banner must not clip).
- **Serve**: `python3 -m http.server 8150`; view at `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- **Reference site**: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` for original button/option-card/link states.
- Keep changes minimal; no unrelated file edits; no debug code; do not commit.
- Playwright available in `node_modules` for browser verification.

- Confirmed `start-card.py` does not exist at `~/.agents/bin/`

part.text:
## Objective
- Redesign the MTD quiz (Variant A) from a "modal with inner scroll" to a "full-screen page with normal document scroll," then apply the original Sage site's link states (default/hover/focus-visible/active) and button/option-card states (default/hover/pressed/focus) on shared classes only.

## Important Details
- **Architecture**: `build-variants.js` is the single source of truth; it patches `mtd-income-tax/index.html` (line 35: `const SRC = path.join(HERE, 'mtd-income-tax', 'index.html')`) to produce `variant-a/index.html` and `variant-b/index.html`. Do NOT edit variants by hand.
- **Modal HTML (from build-variants.js)**: `MODAL_SRC` (line 65) with backdrop, panel, head (h2+close), iframe, foot; `MODAL_FIGMA_A` (line 79) with hidden title, no head close, close in foot. Trigger is `<a class="score-button button--secondary" href="#mtd-quiz-modal" data-mtd-quiz-trigger aria-haspopup="dialog" …` (line 175).
- **Quiz embedding**: Same-origin iframe (`#mtd-quiz-frame` / `#mtd-quiz-modal-frame`). `quiz-frame.js` sizes iframe via `scrollHeight`; `quiz-modal.js` handles focus-trap/dialog; `variant-quiz.js` injects Figma CSS and clicks past entry card.
- **Variant A modal CSS**: `.mtd-quiz-modal` is `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9…` — must be removed/rewritten for full-screen normal scroll.
- **`.mtd-quiz-frame`** (confirmed from quiz-page.css): `display:block; width:100%; min-height:640px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:var(--theme-background-color)`.
- **Frozen bundle tokens**: styled-components suffixes (`fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`) and `Questions-styles__*` classes.
- **Repo hard rule (AGENTS.md line 17)**: One appearance per button class; `node tooling/check-interaction-contract.js` enforces via headless Chromium + static selector check. No override selectors, no context aliases.
- **check-interaction-contract.js confirmed structure**: GROUPS = `{secondary:['button--secondary'], primary:['button-checkout','button--primary'], tertiary:['button-tertiary']}`; ALIASES map `product-card-cta-*-alt`; PAGES = 5 entries incl. `mtd-income-tax/index.html`; CANONICAL_CSS = `[mtd-income-tax/main.css, page/main.css]`. Static part: no button-state rule outside CANONICAL_CSS. Dynamic part: headless Chromium computed-style comparison per GROUP.
- **States skill**: `skills/shared/states.md` — "Write rest, hover, focus, and active before editing any of them. One state fixed alone leaves the same defect on the next state."
- **No dedicated link-guideline file found**: Link states must be derived from `main.css` shared `.score-button`/link rules or the Sage reference site.
- **Two directory copies exist**: `mtd-income-tax/` (primary, larger CSS/JS) and `page/` (older/simpler copy). AGENTS.md route says quiz: `page/quiz/`.
- **Quiz app entry**: `mtd-income-tax/quiz/index.html` + `vendor/` subdirectory + `assets/`, `favicon.svg`, `solution-finder-glow.svg`, `robots.txt`.
- **Verification**: `node tooling/check-interaction-contract.js`, `check-spacing`, `check-markup`; browser-verify at 1280×720 & 1024×540 (Q2 "Before continuing" banner must not clip).
- **Serve**: `python3 -m http.server 8150`; view at `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

## Objective
- Redesign MTD quiz Variant A from "modal with inner scroll" to "full-screen page with normal document scroll," then apply the original Sage site's link states (default/hover/focus-visible/active) and button/option-card states on shared classes only.

## Important Details
- **Architecture**: `build-variants.js` is the single source of truth; patches `mtd-income-tax/index.html` → `variant-a/index.html` + `variant-b/index.html`. Do NOT edit variants by hand.
- **Modal HTML**: `MODAL_SRC` (line ~65) with backdrop/panel/head/iframe/foot; `MODAL_FIGMA_A` (line ~79) with hidden title, close-in-foot; trigger `<a class="score-button button--secondary" href="#mtd-quiz-modal" data-mtd-quiz-trigger …>` (line ~175).
- **Quiz embedding**: Same-origin iframe (`#mtd-quiz-frame` / `#mtd-quiz-modal-frame`). `quiz-frame.js` sizes iframe via `scrollHeight`; `quiz-modal.js` handles focus-trap/dialog; `variant-quiz.js` injects Figma CSS and clicks past entry card.
- **Variant A modal CSS**: `.mtd-quiz-modal` is `position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:9…` — must be removed/rewritten for full-screen normal scroll.
- **`.mtd-quiz-frame`**: `display:block; width:100%; min-height:640px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:var(--theme-background-color)`.
- **Frozen bundle tokens**: styled-components suffixes (`fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`) and `Questions-styles__*` classes.
- **Repo hard rule (AGENTS.md line 17)**: One appearance per button class. `check-interaction-contract.js` enforces via static selector check + dynamic headless-Chromium computed-style comparison.
- **check-interaction-contract.js**: GROUPS = `{secondary:['button--secondary'], primary:['button-checkout','button--primary'], tertiary:['button-tertiary']}`; ALIASES map `product-card-cta-*-alt`; PAGES = 5 entries; CANONICAL_CSS = `[mtd-income-tax/main.css, page/main.css]`. Static check: `isButtonStateSelector` requires a state pseudo-class **AND** a BUTTON_CLASSES token — link states on non-button-class `a` elements are **exempt** from this check. Dynamic check: top-level documents only (does not enter iframes).
- **main.css is NOT regenerable from local source**: `tooling/style-registry-build.js` (28 lines) builds `style-registry-built.json` from `style-registry.json` — it does NOT produce CSS. main.css (2.17 MB) is a static vendor bundle; AGENTS.md forbids hand-editing it.
- **Link-state implication**: Since the static check only flags BUTTON_CLASSES state rules, link states (on `a` without button classes) can be defined in page CSS. Button-class states remain constrained to main.css (which we cannot edit).
- **States skill**: `skills/shared/states.md` — "Write rest, hover, focus, and active before editing any of them."
- **Two directory copies**: `mtd-income-tax/` (primary) and `page/` (older/simpler). AGENTS.md route: `page/quiz/`.
- **Reference site**: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` for original button/option-card/link states.
- Keep changes minimal; no unrelated file edits; no debug code; do not commit.
- Playwright available in `node_modules` for browser verification.
- Serve: `python3 -m http.server 8150`; view at `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed `start-card.py` does not exist at `~/.agents/bin/`
- Read `skills/ROUTE.md` → `skills/shared/states.md` (4-state rule)
- Explored both `mtd-income-tax/` and `page/` directory structures; confirmed `page/` is older/smaller copy
- Read `build-variants.js` (truncated at line 41, section-boundaries comment): confirmed SRC/OUT paths, modal HTML constants, trigger markup; full file not yet read past line 41

- Cannot add new button-class state rules to main.css (vendor bundle, AGENTS.md forbids editing) — must verify which states already exist before deciding scope

## Objective
- Redesign MTD quiz Variant A from "modal with inner scroll" to "full-screen page with normal document scroll," then apply the original Sage site's link states (default/hover/focus-visible/active) and button/option-card states on shared classes only.

## Important Details
- **Architecture**: `build-variants.js` is the single source of truth; patches `mtd-income-tax/index.html` → `variant-a/index.html` + `variant-b/index.html`. Do NOT edit variants by hand.
- **Modal HTML**: `MODAL_SRC` (line ~65) with backdrop/panel/head/iframe/foot; `MODAL_FIGMA_A` (line ~79) with hidden title, close-in-foot; trigger `<a class="score-button button--secondary" href="#mtd-quiz-modal" data-mtd-quiz-trigger …>` (line ~175).
- **Quiz embedding**: Same-origin iframe (`#mtd-quiz-frame` at **line 1150** of `index.html` / `#mtd-quiz-modal-frame` at **line 2830**). `quiz-frame.js` (at `mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js`) sizes iframe via `scrollHeight`; `quiz-modal.js` handles focus-trap/dialog; `variant-quiz.js` injects Figma CSS and clicks past entry card.
- **Variant A modal CSS**: `.mtd-quiz-modal` is `position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:9…` — must be removed/rewritten for full-screen normal scroll.
- **`.mtd-quiz-frame`**: `display:block; width:100%; min-height:640px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:var(--theme-background-color)`.
- **Frozen bundle tokens**: styled-components suffixes (`fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`) and `Questions-styles__*` classes.
- **Repo hard rule (AGENTS.md line 17)**: One appearance per button class. `check-interaction-contract.js` enforces via static selector check + dynamic headless-Chromium computed-style comparison.
- **check-interaction-contract.js**: GROUPS = `{secondary:['button--secondary'], primary:['button-checkout','button--primary'], tertiary:['button-tertiary']}`; ALIASES map `product-card-cta-*-alt`; PAGES = 5 entries; CANONICAL_CSS = `[mtd-income-tax/main.css, page/main.css]`. Static check: `isButtonStateSelector` requires a state pseudo-class **AND** a BUTTON_CLASSES token — link states on non-button-class `a` elements are **exempt**. Dynamic check: top-level documents only (does not enter iframes).
- **main.css is NOT regenerable**: `tooling/style-registry-build.js` (28 lines) builds `style-registry-built.json` from `style-registry.json` — does NOT produce CSS. main.css (2.17 MB) is a static vendor bundle; AGENTS.md forbids hand-editing.
- **Link-state implication**: Static check only flags BUTTON_CLASSES state rules; link states (on `a` without button classes) can be defined in page CSS.
- **States skill**: `skills/shared/states.md` — "Write rest, hover, focus, and active before editing any of them."
- **Reference site**: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` for original button/option-card/link states.
- Keep changes minimal; no unrelated file edits; no debug code; do not commit.
- Playwright available in `node_modules` for browser verification.
- Serve: `python3 -m http.server 8150`; view at `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- **Key open decision**: keep iframe in normal document flow (simpler) vs. fully inline quiz content into page (invasive).

3:    follow the quiz's own screen-change event. Under file:// the read is blocked
4:    by the browser's opaque origin; the CSS min-height then keeps the frame
5:    usable. */
6: (function () {
7:   var frame = document.getElementById("mtd-quiz-frame");
8:   if (!frame) return;
9:   var timer = 0;
10: 
11:   function fit() {
12:     try {
13:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
14:       if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) return;
15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );
20:       if (height > 0) {
21:         var next = Math.ceil(height);
22:         if (Math.abs(frame.getBoundingClientRect().height - next) > 1) {
23:           frame.style.height = next + "px";
24:         }
25:       }
26:     } catch (error) {

28:     }
